entry.title: At least $659 million spent on Ohio's 2026 races for Senate, governor and the U.S. House.
entry.line: The total spent on Ohio's 2026 races, from the filings, then race by race: the Senate race at $432.5 million, the governor's race at $114.9 million and the fifteen U.S. House races at $111.6 million; who paid, what kind of committee each is and who funds it, what it bought, and the disclosure rules.
